 Two rising stars in the featherweight division go toe-to-toe at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi today as Aaron Pico enters as a 57% favorite against Losene Keita.

 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita 
 Oct. 24 • UFC 333 
 moneyline pick 
 Losene Keita to win (44%) 
 Trade at 
 Aaron Pico vs. Losene Keita may look like a traditional grappler vs. striker matchup on paper, but both fighters are more than willing to stand and trade.
 Pico isn’t afraid to engage in chaotic exchanges, but he’ll be up against a slightly taller, longer opponent with legitimate one-punch knockout power.
 With takedowns unlikely to come easy, I expect Keita to get the better of Pico on the feet.
 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita top pick: Fight to NOT go the distance
 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita 
 Oct. 24 • UFC 333 
 top pick 
 Fight to NOT go the distance (67%) 
 Trade at 
 This fight looks like it’s set up to be a car crash between an immovable object and an unstoppable force.
 Pico is a hardheaded warrior who won’t back down, even if he’s overmatched on the feet. He earned a decision win over Patricio Pitbull last time out, but the 38-year-old left Pico bloodied after just one round. Now imagine what a bigger, more dynamic striker like Keita could do.
 Keita has 11 knockout wins (and one KO loss) in 19 professional bouts, while 16 of Pico’s 19 fights have ended before the final bell.
 COVERS INTEL: Pico’s Significant Strike Defense is just 45%, much lower than Keita’s (64%) and most of the featherweight division . 
 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita prop: Keita by KO/TKO/DQ
 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita 
 Oct. 24 • UFC 333 
 Prop pick 
 Keita by KO/TKO/DQ (32%) 
 Trade at 
 Keita has earned a KO in 11 of his last 13 wins, and he’ll have an easy target to hit in Pico.
 Pico is only 30 years old, but there are already questions about his durability. He’s been knocked out four times since 2019, and he’s a little more than a year removed from a brutal spinning elbow KO from Lerone Murphy.
 Keita has one-punch knockout power, and he’ll find his mark Saturday.
 Aaron Pico vs Losene Keita combo

 combo 
 Keita by KO/TKO/DQ
Fight ends before Round 3
(18% Probability) 
 Trade at 
 Four of Pico’s last six fights have ended in the first round (two wins, two losses), while Keita has earned a knockout victory within the first two rounds in four of his last seven bouts.
 Both guys are willing to stand and trade in the pocket, but only one has one-punch knockout power, and that’s Keita.
 Takedowns will be Pico’s path to victory, but Keita boasts 100% takedown defense in the UFC. The bigger, stronger fighter will be difficult to keep down even if Pico manages to get him to the ground.
